# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Nasdaq fell 5.3% as Nvidia lost 14%. Here is how the AI rout reaches your 401(k).](https://fiopoin.com/): Saturday, November 21, 2026. The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday and turned negative for 2026 as Nvidia dropped 14.01% after a Reuters report that SEC staff are reviewing its accounting. The S&P 500 lost 3.70%, closed in correction and fell 8.6% for the week. Bitcoin slipped below $60,000.
- [Gas, rates and Thanksgiving: Gas fell to $3.69, its lowest since March, as markets price in a December rate hike.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and oil: Iran sets seven conditions to reopen Hormuz. Oil still posts a third weekly loss.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [Nvidia: Nvidia's 14% fall follows an SEC report, a CEO exit and a state subpoena.](https://fiopoin.com/#ai)
- [Gold, Bitcoin and bonds: Gold and Bitcoin fell with stocks. Treasury bonds were the shelter.](https://fiopoin.com/#havens)
